name: Twitch Emotes WoW Forever
summary: Adds animated Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ emotes to WoW Forever chat, with search, autocomplete, favorites, and per-channel controls.

gallery.title: Browse your emote collection
gallery.caption: Search emote previews, manage favorites and hidden names, and enable a group directly from Browse.

gallery.title: Customize emotes in chat
gallery.caption: Adjust emote size and animation playback, choose chat types, and control which group supplies shared names.

gallery.title: Choose your channel groups
gallery.caption: Search 66 groups and tick the channels you want to see in chat, with General and five groups enabled by default.
